subtitle: A pebble beach outside Budva, Montenegro, that hosted the Rolling Stones in 2007 and Madonna in 2008, then watched its own follow-on festival collapse when the headliners it promised never came.
spike_statement: A Montenegro pebble beach hosted the Rolling Stones and Madonna within 14 months of independence, then its own 2009 festival's promised headliners never showed.

levers.photo_tone: Pale gray-tan pebble shingle under flat Adriatic light, cut after dark by a floodlit concert stage; no white sand anywhere in frame.
